title: The Bomb
description: At the end of [blue]3[/blue] turns, deal [blue]40[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: At the end of [blue]3[/blue] turns, deal [blue]40[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Counter power that decrements by 1 at the end of each turn. When the counter reaches 1, the bomb detonates at the end of that turn, dealing 40 damage to all enemies and removing itself.
